School Administrator Job at Lantern of Knowledge International Schools




        
    

        
        Lantern of Knowledge International Schools (LKIS) is recruiting suitable candidates to fill the position below:

 Job Position: School Administrator 

Job Location: Mowe-Ibafo, Ogun
Job type: Full-time

Requirements


	B.Ed. or B.Sc. with PGDE
	TRCN certification is an added advantage
	Relevant educational /  administrative experience preferred
	Strong communication, organisational and leadership skills.


Why Join us
     

            
    




	Be part of a growing school with a clear vision
	Opportunities for professional growth and development
	Supportive and collaborative working environment
	Free shared, conducive accommodation for eligible staff, subject to availability
	Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on young lives. 


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a brief application letter to: [email protected] using the  Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Front Desk Officer Job at Ziki Eye Care




        
    

        
        Ziki Eye Care is a renowned center specialized in Excellent eye care services with the use of modern diagnostic equipments and a team of well experienced optometrists, ophthalmologist and optician.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Front Desk Officer
Job Location: Festac, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time 

Description
     

            
    




	Record keeping using MS - excel -this requires good computer skills
	Welcoming of patients to the clinic in a highly professional manner
	Inventory records
	Responding to calls from patients
	Sales recording and submission of daily reports


Skills:


	Must be proficient with MS Excel
	Must be able to communicate effectively
	Must be able to multitask


Other Requirements:


	Applicant must have completed the compulsory 1-year NYSC
	Applicant must reside in Lagos (within Festac or close to its environs)
	Applicant must have excellent computer skills


Salary
N120,000 - N150,000 monthly..

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to: [email protected] using "Application for Front Desk (Festac)" as the subject of the email.
